basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old LEGO enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. I've recently rekindled my childhood passion for LEGO, especially the Star Wars series. I work as a web developer, which means I spend a fair amount of my time online, usually during late evenings after work. I'm currently single and enjoy listening to podcasts about true crime and the automotive industry in my free time. I'm still getting the hang of Reddit, but I'm enjoying exploring new communities and engaging in discussions about my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, which I pursued in college. I've been self-teaching myself web development through various online resources and projects. My interest in LEGO and Star Wars started in childhood and has been reignited in recent months, leading me to explore related communities on Reddit.
